# `auth_challenge`

A password-verified sign-in awaiting MFA and/or tenant choice. Short-lived, attempt-limited.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Owner module | platform |
| Kind | infrastructure |
| Tenant scope | Not tenant scoped |
| Runtime access | Granted to runtime roles (see migration grants) |
| Effective / recorded time | `created_at` |
| Retention class | `authentication`: Credentials, MFA secrets and sessions: kept while the account exists; sessions and challenges purged after expiry plus a security review window. Period: not yet decided. |
| API mapping | — |
| Write path | AuthService only. |
| Migration behaviour | Created in 0005_auth (expand). |

## Constraints

- PK (id)
- unique token_hash (sha256)
- expires_at > created_at
- attempts >= 0
